comparison.objective: Replace an electric-toothbrush head and discard the worn head.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually stabilize the handle, overcome an axial press fit, open packaging, align and press on a replacement.
comparison.success_condition: New head fully seated within 3 mm, worn head in bin, arms returned; partial credit for removal or seating alone.
comparison.reason: Shares axial alignment and disposal only as generic primitives; its central ability is reversible press-fit replacement, not notch fracture with insert-retention and exhaustive fragment containment.
